zh.title: 多种云高来源与卫星云图
zh.summary: 扩展云高参考方式，优化云层规划与图解体验。

items.text: 单层与分层均支持预报云底、云量剖面、温湿剖面和手动海拔；预报云底按离地高度归入对应云层。
云图增加卫星实况对照，切回预报时恢复所选模型与计算时刻。
精简六个升落按钮、时间条和云高控件布局，收起来源说明，并优化图解加载提示。
修复无升落时刻时切换卫星与预报云图、银心目标在切换页面后丢失的问题。

en.title: Cloud height sources and satellite imagery
en.summary: More cloud-height reference methods and clearer planning controls.

items.text: Both views support forecast base, cloud-cover profiles, temperature/dew-point estimates and manual altitude; forecast bases are assigned to the matching AGL band.
Added satellite observations as a map option, restoring the selected forecast model and calculation time when switching back.
Streamlined rise/set buttons, time and height controls, collapsed source explanations and improved diagram loading feedback.
Fixed satellite/forecast switching without a rise/set time and retained the Galactic Center selection across tabs.
